description: Source code for the PCA9633 I2C LED driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing LED control functions such as blinking, brightness setting, and on/off control.

methods.name: pca9633_led_blink
methods.description: Controls LED blinking with specified on/off delays.

methods.name: pca9633_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of a specific LED.

methods.name: pca9633_led_init
methods.description: Initializes the PCA9633 LED driver, configures I2C and driver parameters.
